generator: U-CLEANUP-E2 (manual populate; bootstrap-golf.mjs A6 seeded the empty shell); U-DOCU-04 (MS-DOCU-INGEST) appended golf-blueprint-join-refresh weekly cron
notes: Hygiene prompts the golf-slot chat schedules via CronCreate at session start. Times intentionally off the :00/:30 marks per fleet-friendly scheduling (jitter reduces shared-tree contention across the 7-slot fleet). Distinct from Windows Task Scheduler health scripts in scripts/system-health/ — those run regardless of which chat is open; these are in-session golf reminders for fleet hygiene the golf chat owns. Per-cron lockfile at .cron-locks/<id>.lock prevents the same prompt from re-firing while a prior fire is still working. Two entries (golf-state-snapshot, golf-blueprint-join-refresh) intentionally pair with a Windows Scheduled Task sibling — the in-session prompt is a cheap freshness/plan check (e.g. -DryRun) and the Windows task does the heavy work regardless of which chat is open.

crons.name: Stale-claim sweep
crons.description: Audit stale milestone claims (read-only) via handoff-staleness.mjs. Surfaces claims whose owning chat has been silent >4h. Release is owned by reap-stale-claims.mjs. Targets the /peer-audit skill once U-CLEANUP-B4 ships; until then the prompt invokes the script directly so the cron is never a no-op.
crons.prompt: Run node .claude/helpers/handoff-staleness.mjs --json and surface any dead-owner handoffs or unknown-heartbeat claims to the chat bus. Future: this becomes /peer-audit when U-CLEANUP-B4 lands.

crons.name: Daily golf-state backup
crons.description: Daily backup of golf coordination state — coordination.db + golf-*.json + bug_attribution JSONL dump to H:/prism-backups/golf-state/<ISO>/. 30-day retention. Also runs via Windows Task Scheduler (30-golf-state-snapshot.ps1) for resilience when no golf chat is open.
crons.prompt: Run scripts/golf-state-snapshot.mjs --json and report deltas vs last 7 snapshots.

crons.name: Wiki lint sweep
crons.description: Lint architecture wiki for stale entries, broken cross-refs, orphans. Auto-emits WIKI_LINT_REPORT.md to state/shared/dashboards/. expectedDurationMs sized for a 700+ entry sweep at ~1s/entry; with STALE_GRACE_MULT=4 the lockfile grace is 20 min, covering legitimate sweeps without spurious self-steal.

crons.name: Frontend-merge nudge
crons.description: Re-emit /frontend-merge-plan when BUILD_STATE.frontendsPending > 0 and the last nudge is >24h old. Posts a chat-bus message rather than blocking.

crons.name: Close-out audit + CLAUDE.md drift
crons.description: Regenerate CLOSE-OUT-CANDIDATES.{json,md} + CLAUDE_MD_DRIFT_REPORT.md. Surfaces shipped-but-pending milestone units to dashboards; advisory only, never auto-flips envelope status.

crons.name: Blueprint↔program join freshness check
crons.description: Weekly Sunday freshness/plan check on the blueprint↔program join index (Docustrata/.index/blueprint-program-join-full-v6.jsonl). Runs the canonical refresh wrapper in -DryRun mode: skips phase20 + phase16 python execution, just streams the v6 jsonl, parses the first 20 records, validates required keys + match_confidence values, and writes state/shared/blueprint-join-refresh-last.json for ad-hoc audit + chat-bus surfacing (NOT consumed by a hook today; the SessionStart stale-check hook blueprint-join-index-stale-check.mjs reads only v6 jsonl mtime — extending it to also read this validation record is a planned follow-up). Also runs via Windows Task Scheduler ('PRISM Blueprint Join Refresh', registered by .claude/helpers/install-blueprint-join-refresh-task.ps1) for the REAL weekly rebuild — that fires regardless of which chat is open and does the heavy python rebuild; this in-session reminder is the cheap freshness check that surfaces validation results to the chat bus. Same dual-mechanism precedent as golf-state-snapshot.
crons.prompt: Run powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File H:/prism/scripts/system-health/33-blueprint-join-refresh.ps1 -DryRun -Json and surface the v6 join freshness (validation.lineCount, validation.sampleOk, validation.matchConfidenceDistribution, validation.valid) to the chat bus. If validation.valid is false or sampleErrors is non-empty, post a chat-bus warning naming the failure mode so the next non-golf chat triggers the Windows task manually or flips the wrapper to live mode.
